title: Yellowish Yucca Crusted Venezuelan Pork Pabellón Criollo
description: A flavorful, comforting dish originating from Venezuela, blending the crispiest yucca crust with tender sous-vide pork and the richness of Pabellón Criollo.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C) for later use, if desired.
Season the pork cubes with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and cumin. Let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Sous-vide the pork cubes at 130°F (54°C) for 2 hours or until tender.
Meanwhile, mix yucca flour, cooking wine, and a pinch of salt in a bowl until smooth. Adjust the seasoning as needed.
Using a spatula, carefully place the yucca mixture on the salt block and shape it into a flat, even layer.
Once the pork is cooked, remove it from the sous-vide and carefully place it on top of the yucca crust.
Brush olive oil over the yucca crust and place the entire assembly under the broiler for 5 minutes or until golden brown.
While the yucca crust is cooking, heat pork broth in a saucepan over medium heat.
Once the yucca crust is done, carefully transfer the entire assembly to the saucepan with the pork broth.
Simmer for 2-3 minutes, allowing the pork to absorb the flavors.
Serve with sliced green plantains, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
